Generated Narrative: CodeSystem mii-cs-mikrobio-resistenzkategorie

This case-sensitive code system https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/modul-mikrobio/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mikrobio-resistenzkategorie defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
mrsa-status MRSA-StatusDoes the detected pathogen meet the criteria of the category MRSA (methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus)? Basis of assessment: identification as Staphylococcus aureus and detection of methicillin/oxacillin resistance, phenotypically or via mecA/mecC.
vre-status VRE-StatusDoes the detected pathogen meet the criteria of the category VRE (vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus)? Basis of assessment: identification as Enterococcus and detection of vancomycin resistance, phenotypically or via vanA/vanB.
lre-status LRE-StatusDoes the detected pathogen meet the criteria of the category LRE (linezolid-resistant Enterococcus)? Basis of assessment: identification as Enterococcus and detection of linezolid resistance.
lvre-status LVRE-StatusDoes the detected pathogen meet the criteria of the category LVRE (linezolid- and vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus)? Basis of assessment: identification as Enterococcus and detection of both linezolid and vancomycin resistance.

name: MII_CS_Mikrobio_Resistenzkategorie
title: MII CS Microbiology Resistance Category
description: Investigation codes (Observation.code) for assessing a detected pathogen with regard to a defined resistance category. Each code names the assessed category; the result of the assessment is in Observation.value.

concept.definition: Does the detected pathogen meet the criteria of the category MRSA (methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus)? Basis of assessment: identification as Staphylococcus aureus and detection of methicillin/oxacillin resistance, phenotypically or via mecA/mecC.

Does the detected pathogen meet the criteria of the category VRE (vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus)? Basis of assessment: identification as Enterococcus and detection of vancomycin resistance, phenotypically or via vanA/vanB.
Does the detected pathogen meet the criteria of the category LRE (linezolid-resistant Enterococcus)? Basis of assessment: identification as Enterococcus and detection of linezolid resistance.

Does the detected pathogen meet the criteria of the category LVRE (linezolid- and vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus)? Basis of assessment: identification as Enterococcus and detection of both linezolid and vancomycin resistance.
